quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
You may go if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong direction and risk a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign prepares you for what is coming. It tells you a yield sign is ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers in the left lane they must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for workers on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for workers on or near the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers are on or near the road. Drive carefully in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot park here at any time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a side road is ahead. Be ready for traffic entering from the side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that the road will become a divided highway soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to follow the detour because the road ahead is closed or dangerous due to construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means trucks are not allowed on this road.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you reach the speed limit sign.
Start to slow down your vehicle.
Do not slow down because traffic will back up.
Slow down only if you want to.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start to slow down your vehicle.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to begin reducing your speed now. The new speed limit will start at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait until the road is clear before moving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that there are several lanes where drivers can turn left. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: This warning sign means you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always let pedestrians cross safely. Pay attention when driving near intersections and turning, and be ready to stop for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to be alert for hazards ahead and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn about railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane will end. All traffic in the right lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully and slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on the right.
Yield only to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that farm machinery may be driving in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
A winding road is ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves right ahead. You should slow down to the safe speed indicated, which in this case is 35 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Drivers should be careful where pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A bicycle repair shop is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that bicycles may be present in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign warns that a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, they are signaling that they will stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter the road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering or symbols. They warn drivers about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther from the car ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is coming. Watch carefully for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may hit or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in construction zones. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change your normal driving route. Be ready to follow a redirected route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that you must follow. When this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. In bad weather or poor road conditions, always slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that you must follow. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that an intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs show traffic rules that you must follow. This sign is posted in parking lots. It marks reserved parking spaces for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns that the road ahead has many curves. Slow down and adjust your driving.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means you cannot do that action. This sign means no right turns are allowed here.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon become one lane.

questions.question: This sign indicates that:

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. The number shows the fastest speed you can legally drive on this road. If it is raining, snowing, or icy, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: From the center lane, which maneuver(s) can you perform?
questions.explanation: The center lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other cars or to drive straight through traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a red light or watch for crossing traffic.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. You should:

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, move to another lane if it is safe to do so. This makes room for cars entering the freeway.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if you need to.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means that when the light is green, you can turn left. However, you must yield to oncoming traffic first. Only complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns drivers not to enter a roadway from the wrong direction. Stop and turn around when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to safely meet or pass a truck. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What is the main concern when you see this sign?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about an upcoming winding road with three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is merging into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic light colors from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic signal, red is always on top and green is on the bottom. On a horizontal signal, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that the road ahead curves to the right first, then curves to the left.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the highway on a ramp. If you stay in this lane, you will exit. You can change lanes to continue through the interchange instead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers to watch for cattle that may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer may cross the road here. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
A curve is ahead. Speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve is ahead. Speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves ahead in the direction of the arrow. You should drive at the recommended speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand upward, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown (in this case, a right turn) is not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for them to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum safe speed allowed on that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to avoid blocking the intersection. It is posted near intersections where traffic needs to flow freely.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, what does it mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
Due to roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead turns at a sharp angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead turns at a sharp angle.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. Slow down before reaching the curve just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways before crossing the intersection.
You must stop completely at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns you that a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians. This sign shows either a school crossing or a school zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for workers directing traffic.
The road ahead is being worked on.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead is being worked on.
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange and warn you of unusual or dangerous conditions in work zones. This sign tells you a construction zone is coming. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black marks on yellow. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway is about to end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. This sign tells you which direction to drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown.
This lane is for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side the arrow shows.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side the arrow shows.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. An island, median, or barrier is ahead. Stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for hazards ahead. They are usually yellow with black marks. This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to drive on the right side of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What type of road feature does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead and will direct traffic. Follow their instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows that from this lane, you can either turn right or drive straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is under construction.
The road ahead has loose gravel.
The road ahead has been sanded for ice.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has loose gravel.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn about hazards ahead. This sign tells you the road is covered with loose gravel. Drive carefully because your tires will not grip the road as well.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a minimum number of passengers.
Specific turns are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a minimum number of passengers.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and cars with the required number of passengers can use this lane. Check the sign for the exact number.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: This sign prevents:

options.text: Entry from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entry from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic moves in one direction only. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: A green arrow on a lane control signal means:

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a traffic lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing ahead. Watch for people crossing your path. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low overpass ahead. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: These signs indicate:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black text. These object markers warn drivers about dangerous objects or areas to avoid.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic laws that you must obey. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles frequently cross or ride near traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines are doubled in work zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Fines are doubled in work zones.
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange signs warn of construction ahead. This sign tells drivers that penalties for unsafe driving are higher in work zones.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange signs warn of construction ahead. This sign tells drivers that a flagger is ahead to direct traffic. Follow their instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell you to stop. You must yield to other traffic. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up, so you should prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you the rules you must follow. This sign is posted at traffic lights where you cannot turn right when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about construction zones. Be careful and watch for construction workers. This sign tells you that roadwork is starting soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you the rules you must follow. This sign tells you that from this lane, you can either turn left or continue straight at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn about construction zones. This sign tells you to take a different route because the normal road is blocked.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the shoulder of the road is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
